name: Tokyo International Airport (Haneda)

runway.v: four runways; the longest, C, is 3,360 m long and 60 m wide

hours.quote: 空港の運用時間は、２４時間とする。

handling.v: business aviation uses dedicated arrival and departure gates with their own customs and immigration
handling.quote: using dedicated CIQ facilities and arrival and departure gates

missing: customs hours (page says dedicated CIQ but no hours)
notes: The website names no companies other than authorities, airport operators and sources, so the handling_list is for internal use only. The Japanese AIP (aisjapan.mlit.go.jp) could not be opened. The runway/outline sheet (tcab-haneda-outline) shows no date. An undated MLIT business jet pamphlet says daytime business jet movements at Haneda are limited to 8 per day; it was not used because it is undated and likely out of date. Japan has no daylight saving time.
